summary: Tested automatic rubric (category) assignment for FB imports and the new hidden 'Obavještenja' category. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed. They cover the unit cases for detect_categories; the category and menu order; the hidden-category article being excluded from home blocks, the unfiltered list and popular, while it still appears in the category list and its detail page; the live FB import with the AI refinement (notice -> obavjestenja, culture post -> kultura + Cazin); a forced valid slug; an unknown slug falling back to auto; and bad-type categories not crashing. An AI probe on 6 texts showed Claude refines correctly (school news -> obrazovanje + cazin). UI: 100%. The dialog shows 5 category selects with 'Rubrika automatski (prijedlog: X)' and 28 options. Choosing a category does not toggle the checkbox. The import sent the override and the article went into Zanimljivosti. The home page hides the notice, the menu link works, and /kategorija/obavjestenja renders on desktop and at 390px mobile.

minor.issue: Typo 'pljakš' (should be 'pljačk' for pljačka/pljačkaš). 'uhapšen' is listed twice. 'uhapsila/uhapsio' does not match 'uhapšen'; it only worked in the test because of 'policij'. The sport pattern 'dres' has no word boundary, so it matches 'adresa' (weight 1).

The suggested 'category' comes from keywords only, but the import also uses AI. The final rubric can differ from the 'prijedlog' shown to the editor, e.g. a school post shows 'Cazin' but is imported as Obrazovanje.

Only category_id is excluded. An article whose main category is something else but has Obavještenja in category_ids still appears on the home page. Hiding is also skipped for tag, author and search listings. This is probably acceptable.

issues: The count text says '1 rezultata', which is wrong grammar for 1 (should be '1 rezultat').

critical_code_review_comments: The detect_categories hard rule (obavjestenja score >= 4) is checked before the AI result, so death notices are never moved elsewhere by AI. Correct.
re.findall on an alternation regex does not count overlaps, so 'izrazio saučešće' scores 2, not 4. Condolence news is therefore not misfiled as a notice. Verified.
valid_forced filters to existing slugs and string values. Unknown slugs fall back to auto classification. A non-dict value is ignored. Verified.
Hard-deleting FB media removes the DB records only. Any image variant files written by process_image stay on disk or storage.
